# Standard date formats

Coding rule · `S1.4`

Dates/times (all platforms): relative ("18 min ago") under 24 h; MMM D in the current year, MMM D, YYYY otherwise; time h:mm A; timezone only on scheduled activities.

Part of [[Hubs/Coding rules|Coding rules]].
